text:
Evan R.: Quick heads-up: CipherNode (secrets mgr) + IronHSM (hardware partner) integration kickoff. Core asks from partner: SAML SP-initiated, SCIM v2 provisioning, KMS passthrough with HSM attest, and a marketplace SKU that exposes HSM-backed offering. Need owners + timeline.

Priya S.: Ill take SAML + SCIM mapping. Can we require SCIM group sync for entitlement mapping?

Noah T.: Ill handle KMS passthrough and HSM attestation flow. Need to confirm attestation format (TPM vs PKCS#7 chain).

Jordan K.: Marketplace/GTN owner here. We need SKU names, plan tiers, and how to show "HSM-backed" badge. Also want embargo/launch window.

Evan R.: Partners asked for an "early access" listing by 2026-07-01 and public marketing 2026-07-20. Legal wants quotes cleared by 07-10.

Priya S.: SCIM: recommend required attributes = userName (email), name, active, groups. For group->entitlement mapping: map SCIM group -> marketplace entitlement id. Will draft mapping doc.

Noah T.: KMS passthrough notes: IronHSM requires mutual TLS + attestation cert chain. They also want us to accept HSM-derived wrapping keys via our wrap/unwrap API. Minimal test curl:
```
curl -X POST https://kms.redwood.example.com/v1/wrap \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"key_handle":"ironhsm-0001","plaintext":"<base64>"}' \ 
  --cert redwood-int-client.pem --key redwood-int-client.key --cacert ironhsm-test-ca.pem
```
We should provide a reference client cert and an HSM test vector.

Jordan K.: For the marketplace: propose two SKUs: "CipherNode (Hosted)" and "CipherNode + IronHSM (Dedicated/HSM)". Pricing note: HSM SKU will be listed as "Contact sales" for pricing but show per-seat software price. Need UX mock by next Tue.

Priya S.: SAML checklist: SP metadata, ACS URL, signature alg, NameID format (emailAddress), attribute mapping for email, givenName, familyName, and groups (saml:attribute "groups"). Also ask for test IdP.

Noah T.: IronHSM wants HKDF + RSA-OAEP wrapping variants supported. Ill add unit tests for both. Also request HSM attestation sample (JSON Web Sig) to validate key origin.

Evan R.: Action items: @Priya prepare SAML+SCIM integration guide; @Noah produce KMS passthrough test harness + attestation verification steps; @Jordan prepare marketplace SKU copy + mock; Ill coordinate partner comms and timeline.

Jordan K.: Also: we need clarity on billing/entitlement enforcement for dedicated HSM customers. Do we bill via marketplace metered usage, or via contract for dedicated nodes? Ops + finance to weigh in.

LegalBot: Reminder: any partner quotes or logos require signed MSA + logo usage form before public release. Submit draft quotes by 2026-07-05.

Priya S.: I'll create a sample SCIM PATCH for group assignment and include it in the guide. Example: `PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/<id>` with operations add/remove.

Noah T.: Scheduling: propose a technical workshop with both partner eng teams on Fri 08:00 PT for 60 mins. Who can attend?

Evan R.: I can.

Priya S.: I can.

Jordan K.: Ill join first 20 mins for SKU signoff.

InfraBot: External meeting invite created for eng@ciphernode.com and infra@ironhsm.com  https://meet.example.com/tech-workshop-ironhsm

Noah T.: Adding integration repo template to git (partners/ciphernode-ironhsm) with: SAML sample metadata, SCIM sample payloads, KMS wrap/unwrap client example, and HSM attestation validator. Will ping when ready.

Evan R.: Great. Keep blockers here. If Secure/Infra have compliance asks (FIPS, FedRAMP), flag early. :rocket:
